name: 代码调试与修复
description: 调试和修复 bug 的场景，使用多种评分方法验证修复结果

tasks.title: 修复除零错误
tasks.prompt: 修复 /workspace/stats.py 中的 average 函数。当输入空列表时抛出了 ZeroDivisionError，请添加适当的错误处理并确保返回合理的值。同时修复列表包含非数字元素时的问题。

fixtures.content:
def average(numbers):
    """Calculate the average of a list of numbers."""
    total = sum(numbers)
    count = len(numbers)
    return total / count  # BUG: ZeroDivisionError on empty list

def median(numbers):
    """Calculate the median"""
    sorted_nums = sorted(numbers)
    n = len(sorted_nums)
    mid = n // 2
    return sorted_nums[mid]  # BUG: doesn't handle even-length correctly

def stats(numbers):
    """Return dict with avg, median, min, max"""
    return {
        "avg": average(numbers),
        "median": median(numbers),
        "min": min(numbers),  # BUG: ValueError on empty list
        "max": max(numbers),  # BUG: ValueError on empty list
        "count": len(numbers)
    }
